eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 33 · Grouping and Aggregating

code:
SELECT SUM(ListPrice) AS TotalListPrice
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Adds every non-NULL value into one total.

code:
SELECT AVG(ListPrice) AS AverageListPrice
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Sum divided by count — built in, not something you compute yourself.

eyebrow: Both skip NULL — this matters for AVG
code:
-- If NULL counted as zero, this would
-- artificially pull the average DOWN
SELECT AVG(Weight) AS AverageWeight
FROM Production.Product;
caption: NULL is skipped, not treated as 0 — the average reflects only real values.
WHERE filters first — the average covers only red products.
